verdict.rationale: a-Shell has an optional relay HTTPS server that authenticates POST /run with an X-Token, so credential issuance is a fair question here. However, nothing in the evidence shows scoped, per-agent or least-privilege tokens. The README notes that in-app commands share the app's sandbox and can read its credential files, with no isolation between commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
